cause: An X11 clipboard selection owner forked by xclip inherited the test logging pipe. Python could exit successfully while tee waited for EOF; the shell could not reach Xvfb cleanup, which would have released the clipboard owner.

local_control.regression: Confirm writer.wait() == 0 while communicate() still times out, replace the negative-control selection to release it, then confirm the fixed writer closes its logs and its Unicode clipboard remains readable after its process exits.

fix: Use one UTF-8 clipboard writer helper that redirects only the xclip owner's stdout/stderr to DEVNULL. Preserve the clipboard owner for subsequent paste. Record pytest-return, interpreter-exit and pipeline-exit boundaries.
